headline: Brazilian Senate schedules vote on public security constitutional amendment
summary: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a floor vote on the Public Security Constitutional Amendment (PEC 18/2025), a key legislative initiative of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
why: Major constitutional amendments regarding public security and federal-state policing powers influence legal predictability, institutional risk premiums, and domestic governance in Brazil.
